import csv
ids = {
 "cooling":"fdc274e5-2d8d-5912-b772-33d6f22754de",
 "heating":"b9e02d5a-51b2-5824-9d33-fb37e85358f5",
 "temp":"855b75f9-c426-5619-badc-0df50869f3f6",
}
data = {k:{} for k in ids}
with open(VALUES_CSV, newline='') as f:
    r = csv.DictReader(f)
    for row in r:
        ts=row['timeseries_id']
        for k,v in ids.items():
            if ts==v:
                data[k][row['timestamp']] = float(row['value'])
date="2018-01-14"
cool = data['cooling'][date+'T01:00:00']
heat = data['heating'][date+'T01:00:00']
# ensure constant
cool_set = set(data['cooling'].values())
heat_set = set(data['heating'].values())
print("cooling distinct:", cool_set)
print("heating distinct:", heat_set)
ok=True
violations=[]
for t, temp in sorted(data['temp'].items()):
    if not t.startswith(date): continue
    c = data['cooling'].get(t)
    h = data['heating'].get(t)
    if temp > c or temp < h:
        ok=False
        violations.append((t, temp, h, c))
print("ok:", ok)
print("violations:", violations[:20])
print("num temp values:", len([t for t in data['temp'] if t.startswith(date)]))
